methodology: The authors fine-tune a transformer-based model on a Reddit corpus, evaluating against a held-out test set drawn from BPD-related subreddits.
findings: The model achieves competitive recall and precision against a CNN baseline, with attention visualisations highlighting affective language as the strongest predictive signal.
relevance_to_research: Directly relevant to the student's BPD detection thesis, particularly the use of attention-based architectures on Reddit text.
limitations: Single-subreddit training and absence of demographic controls limit generalisability; the authors acknowledge potential annotator bias.
